metadata.case_name: LAM SAU YING v. SHIU YAT SANG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: employee of a food stall / fast food restaurant worker

injuries.description: head injury over right occipital area with a scalp hematoma of one cm diameter
source: (a) head injury over right occipital area with a scalp hematoma of one cm diameter;
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

injuries.description: fracture of the proximal left medical tibia condyle and avulsion fracture of tibia spine
source: (b) fracture of the proximal left medical tibia condyle and avulsion fracture of tibia spine.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of tibia, medial condyle

manifestations.description: bad memory / forgetfulness (forgetting to buy things, forgetting about picking up her son, forgetting that she had boiled water)
residual headache and non-specific giddiness / dizziness; headaches two to three times a week lasting about one hour each time
pain in left leg increased by weather change; numbness in leg when seated for long; pain after walking about 20 minutes or standing about 30 minutes; pain increases when climbing stairs
limp when walking; stands with weight on right leg; wasting of thigh muscles; limitation of full flexion; 5o varus deformity of left knee; unable to squat fully (can only half squat)
reduced ability to stand for long periods (can only stand about 20 minutes) and reduced ability to walk long distances (needs rest after walking about 30 minutes)
inability to cycle and inability to pursue previous sports/hobbies (walking, cycling, playing badminton, football and swimming)

treatments_received: close reduction and arthroscopic fixation of left tibial spine on 18 July 2001
transferred to a rehabilitation hospital where she remained for two months
attended 22 sessions of physiotherapy from 3 October to 9 November 2001
left knee arthroscopic release (during admission 12 November to 24 November 2001)
attended five more sessions of physiotherapy from 27 November to 10 December 2001
admitted to hospital for physical therapy exercises from 12 December to 21 December 2001
attended eight sessions of physiotherapy between 21 December 2001 and 24 January 2002

losses.description: bad memory / forgetfulness and mild cognitive impairment consistent with mild post-concussional syndrome
reduced ability to stand for long periods, reduced walking tolerance, pain and limp affecting mobility and stair climbing

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: cannot do household chores and had to leave them to her husband

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: could no longer cycle, swim, play badminton or football as before the accident
